artifact_review_corrections.initial_assertion: GL consumer must show a support-tools checkout
artifact_review_corrections.observed: The pinned official GL action downloads tt_submission, selects the PDK from its metadata and compiles the downloaded physical netlist. It does not check out support tools.
artifact_review_corrections.corrected_verification: Require the exact downloaded archive ID/digest, actual workflow source checkout, exact PDK activation/cache key, physical netlist/model compile command, all required public groups and unchanged records. Support checkout verification remains required for precheck.

observed_ciel_action.boundary: The official composite retains internally tagged dependencies; observed identities and source content are retained, without claiming all transitive actions are repository-pinned.

job_log_handling: Retain decoded job-log hashes; redact temporary URL query strings in committed compressed copies and record both hashes. Unredacted local downloads remain ignored.
